title: SA/102/2007 of JAGNARAYAN ( SINCE DECEASED) Vs ISWARI PRASAD

COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
12.04.2023 SA No. 102 of 2007
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Alok Mahra and Mr. D.C.S.
Rawat, Advocates for the appellants.
Mr. Bharat Tewari, Advocate for the
respondent.
The Order-sheet reflects that the
appellants herein were granted time to carry out
the necessary substitution in order to bring on
record the heirs of the deceased respondent, but,
despite of an opportunity being granted, as back
as on 17.05.2018 and 07.12.2020, no
substitution has been filed.
Since, Second Appeal being a
proceedings governed by the provisions
contained under Section 108 of the C.P.C., the
same would stand abated, under Order 22 Rule
9 of C.P.C.
The Second Appeal is accordingly
dismissed, as having abated.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 12.04.2023
PN/-
